_comment: Adopter overlay-exemption config (see docs/adopter-guide.md). List your OWN private-overlay directory NAME(s) in extra_exempt_dirs to keep that top-level directory out of the content gates (including the PII/secrets/placeholder scanners) without editing tool source. Each entry is a bare directory name matched TOP-LEVEL-ANCHORED: it exempts only <name>/ directly under the repository root, never a nested directory or file of that name. A shipped corpus/tooling directory name (or an absolute/multi-segment/empty value) is rejected and skipped with a warning, so the config can never blind a gate over library content. The shipped library carries an empty list.
